messages:
Alex (Sales): AcmeProc circled BCP/DR on the vendor review. Need a short, pasteable block for RTO/RPO, backup cadence, failover steps, SLA history and DR test evidence. Can SRE + Legal help? :pray:

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can draft. Quick: they ticked "RTO <= 1 hour". Do we ever commit to that?

Omar (SRE): Short answer: Not for Hosted. Hosted = HA ops, best-effort failover, no contractual RTO/RPO. Dedicated can be SLA-backed (99.9% / 99.95%); typical operational RTO for full failover ~2-4 hrs depending on warm pools.

Omar (SRE): Backups/RPO (pasteable): control-plane logs retained per contract (examples: 90/365). Dedicated supports point-in-time snapshots; recommended cadence for near sub-hour RPO = daily full + hourly incremental (customer config). Private = customer-controlled snapshot/replication; RPO per config.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Failover steps short (non-absolute): 1) health detection + traffic reroute; 2) cache/KV prefix fallback (best-effort); 3) promote warm-standby pools if provisioned; 4) DNS/edge failover where configured. Timing depends on topology.

Lena (Legal): Procurement-safe paragraph (pasteable): "Redwood operates a tiered model. Hosted API is operated for high availability but does not include contractual RTO/RPO commitments. Dedicated capacity is covered by contractual uptime SLAs (99.9% standard, 99.95% premium) and documented recovery procedures; specific RTO/RPO, backup cadence, and runbooks are set in the Service Addendum. Private deployments' recovery objectives are agreed case-by-case. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. All responses are subject to the Master Services Agreement."

Omar (SRE): DR testing evidence: "We conduct quarterly DR tabletop exercises and annual live failover tests for Dedicated pools. Private customers coordinate tests with their ops teams. We can provide an anonymized 12-month availability summary and a one-page DR tabletop summary on request."

Alex (Sales): Great — Priya, can you send this as a single pasteable block and attach the runbook excerpt + offer for anonymized metrics? I'll cc Legal. Thanks :raised_hands:

Priya (Solutions Eng): Will send now and confirm here.
